content: Validated Hermes config pattern to reduce output information density: set ~/.hermes/config.yaml tool_output limits to max_bytes: 12000, max_lines: 400, max_line_length: 400; set display options to compact: true, show_reasoning: false, show_cost: false, final_response_markdown: "strip", persistent_output: true, persistent_output_max_lines: 100, and keep resume_skip_tool_only: true enabled.
